messages:
amy_product: Noted a repeat issue: marketplace VM image updates cause version drift for several customers and partners are opening SEVs in their own systems. We need a short, deterministic joint escalation path for marketplace-image incidents.

noah_oncall: Agreed. The worst part is duplicate paging and different status pages. Proposal: single first-hop channel #marketplace-image-escalate (shared) + bot-trigger to create the bridge.

rachel_partnerships: From partners: require a one-line manifest ID and cloud region in the first post so we can correlate. Also request that partners tag the marketplace listing id.

sam_sre: Operational flow: post in #marketplace-image-escalate with MANIFEST=<id> REGION=<region> LISTING=<id> -> marketplace_bot creates #mp-war-<id>, posts runbook link, and notifies both marketplace-oncall + partner-oncall.

marketplace_bot: Trigger recognized. Warroom created: #mp-war-2145678901. Zoom: https://meet.redwood/mp-2145678901. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/marketplace/image-sev-path. Notifying @noah_oncall, @rachel_partnerships. Triage template injected.

noah_oncall: Triage template (bot injects): Impact: (customer-visible/Y/N)
Manifest ID: 
Listing ID: 
Region: 
Symptoms: 
Workarounds tried: 
Owner (org:user): 
Escalation TTL (default 10m): 

amy_product: Add required line: "Image digest (sha256) if available" and "If deployment pinned, include pin target". That helps fast rollbacks.

sam_sre: Add SLA rules: owner assign 10m default, SRE lead ping at 20m, partner exec notify at 60m. Allow per-partner override in config. Bot should also post a one-line public status template partners can copy into their status pages.

rachel_partnerships: We'll provide partner-side oncall emails and a canned customer status template (one paragraph + ETA). Also request a mandatory handback summary so partners know to re-deploy test images and confirm.

noah_oncall: Handback checklist idea: resolved timestamp, remediation summary, image digest used for fix, rollout proportion and automation ref, partner validation steps, link to post-incident follow-up doc. Bot will auto-post handback template when incident marked resolved.

amy_product: Next steps: 1) Sam to add bot trigger + templates (ETA 48h). 2) Rachel to collect partner oncall formats and status template (ETA EOW). 3) Noah to update oncall rotation docs and add the shared channel (ETA EOW). 4) Amy to circulate final process diagram and schedule a 30-min tabletop.

marketplace_bot: Reminder scheduled: "MarketPlace image SEV tabletop" in 7 days.

sam_sre: I'll open the PR for the bot change today and include a sample warroom payload for partners to test.

amy_product: Thanks all 64f. If anybody sees edge cases (multi-region images, signed manifests), drop them here before I finalize the one-pager.
